name: ちびロボ
description: プラグや掃除道具で戦う小さなロボ。NBはプラグの往復打ち、横Bは長押しで飛距離を伸ばすプラグ投げ（床で一度バウンド）。上Bはチビコプターで上昇したあと左右に滑空し、回避で中断。下Bはマグカップで守りながらゆっくり移動する。
extraIntegration: combat-system.js: append *(chibiroboGuarding(o)?.6:1) to incoming damage multiplier expression, adjacent to yuriGuarding. Mug uses normal attack armor <=15dmg, not invulnerability.
newcomer-system gate: chibirobo returns chibiroboGate directly after general rule? Allow ground dash repeat after its ending, only one plug alive; keep shared aerial side-once gate.
No f-state fields beyond attack or Rules.objects: regular Newcomer serialization already captures them. Ensure server allowlist adds chibirobo.
art-loader tint/build-art mask: recolor only metal pixels with saturation<.16 and mean>70, preserve black eyes/cable and gold plug prongs. User colors should be subtle metal hues.
MoveMotion.define uses authored wholebody pose sequences, no synthetic bone transform.
